Thank you for sticking with us and waiting. As a small indie team, your support means a lot to us. This demo is all about tactics. events.title: DEMO DATE REVEAL
events.summary: Hey, players! We've worked on this for a long time and can't wait for you to play it. Thanks so much for all your feedback from the last test. events.title: Playtest is officially closed
events.summary: Alright, Players! Thanks for joining the playtest, fighting through the gamepad controls, and pointing out the rough edges we need to fix. We'll make it better than before, guaranteed! The feedback was gold. Heading off to fix onboarding and tighten up the matches. Catch you next round and be sure to join our Discord.

events.title: Closed playtest begins with new content
events.summary: Hey everyone! The closed playtest is live, and you'll get to test out a bunch of new content. To start with, you'll now be able to finish the 1st neighborhood! 🏙️ But the main focus of this update is the updated match system and NPC AI. This is a big one for us, and we'd love your help testing it. 🎮 Play some matches and share your thoughts/suggestions through our in-game questionnaire (it'll pop up automatically when you close the game). events.title: Football Story Dev Blog #4
events.summary: NPCs Hey everyone! In today’s weekly update, we will be discussing NPCs and why they were added into Football Story in the first place. Authenticity of the game’s environment We wanted to shoot for authenticity, so we ditched the idea of creating an NPC generator where assets were mixed and matched to create the illusion of having 100 “different” NPCs. events.summary: Hey, everyone! We have a lot going on! Most importantly, we have been busy finishing match events and map-related assets. As we were developing the various animations, backdrops, and visual elements for the map, we began brainstorming ideas for how map traversal should actually work. We didn’t want to use a simple point-and-click system that involves a pin symbolizing the hero moving around in a static format.
